title: Fourier coefficient of an indicator polynomial
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $a\in\{\pm1\}^n$. For every set of coordinates $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the polynomial $x\mapsto\prod_{j=0}^{n-1}(1+a_jx_j)/2$ equals $2^{-n}$ times the monomial $\prod_{j\in S}a_j$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a point of the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
$S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
